name: TourSL
blurb: Tour planning and booking platform for multi-day guided tours across Sri Lanka. Led the frontend: a React 18 + TypeScript SPA on Vite with a utility-first Tailwind design system.
detail:
Built the landing experience as a React 18 + TypeScript SPA on Vite with a utility-first Tailwind design system, lucide-react iconography, responsive mobile-first layouts, scroll-driven section reveals and accessible semantic markup. Optimised the bundle via code-splitting and shipped continuous preview and production deploys on Vercel.

Integrated against the Spring Boot service: layered REST, JWT plus Google OAuth, PostgreSQL with Flyway migrations, and slot reservation under optimistic locking.
